headline: Dosing method tracking for every administration

changes.title: Record how each dose was taken
changes.detail: Added Subcutaneous, IM, IV, Oral, Nasal and Topical dosing methods separately from optional injection site in Log Dose, combo doses and prepared syringe logging. Methods appear in dose histories and calendar details.

changes.title: Preserved existing records
changes.detail: Past dose records remain unchanged when a method was not recorded; edits can explicitly add a method. Dose source, inventory calculations, historical associations and backups are preserved.

dataImpact: Non-destructive additive dose.method field on newly recorded or explicitly edited doses. Existing saved doses, personal history, inventory source allocations, protocols and browser storage remain intact; missing legacy methods are not inferred.
limitations: Legacy dose entries without a recorded method remain unspecified until edited.
The combo and prepared-syringe flows are injectable-only; oral, nasal and topical administrations use individual Log Dose.
Production publication, automatic What's New popup, physical iPhone acceptance and Cloudflare parity require independent verification after approved deployment.
